answer:
Python 3.9 has been deprecated across the LlamaIndex packages, but the context doesn't say when it will be fully removed. The March 2026 changelog entries all cite the same change, PR #20956. For example, the `llama-index-instrumentation` 0.5.0 entry reads:

"chore: deprecate python 3.9 once and for all ([#20956](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/pull/20956))" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/CHANGELOG.md]

The same entry appears for `llama-index-embeddings-litellm` 0.5.0 and `llama-index-embeddings-llamafile` 0.5.0 in the same file, and for `llama-index-embeddings-autoembeddings` 0.3.0 and `llama-index-embeddings-azure-inference` 0.5.0 in the March 12, 2026 release.

The context also records an earlier change to Python 3.8. The `llama-index-core` 0.12.0 entry from 2024-11-17 says "Dropped python3.8 support, Unpinned numpy (#16973)" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/CHANGELOG.md]. That entry concerns 3.8, not 3.9.
